claim: GSE162256 profiles A2780 cells after paclitaxel, celecoxib, their combination, or control; the paclitaxel arms used here are 5 nM at 16 and 48 hours.
limitation: This is a chemical-exposure study, not a genetic Perturb-seq experiment.

claim: The quality-filtered processed matrix has 9,664 feature rows and 338 cell columns, including 46 control, 56 paclitaxel 16-hour, and 53 paclitaxel 48-hour cells.
limitation: Cell counts do not establish independent biological culture replication.

claim: All six predeclared cell-cycle markers have lower median reported values at both paclitaxel times than in control cells.
limitation: The overall processed matrix also shifts lower, so marker direction alone is not cell-cycle-specific or a count-based differential-expression estimate.

claim: Among 9,276 features detected in at least 20% of control cells, 69.8% and 64.3% have lower medians at 16 and 48 hours, respectively, than control.
limitation: This is a descriptive feature-wide background in processed E-value units; feature dependence and cell-level sampling preclude an inferential gene-set test.

claim: Three of seven predeclared interferon markers (IFIT3, MX1, OAS1) are absent from the processed A2780 matrix, and the available markers do not show a uniformly higher median after paclitaxel.
limitation: Missing features and zero-heavy expression make this panel inconclusive for cross-context pathway comparison.

claim: The A2780 and HCC1143 single-cell examples differ in cell line, paclitaxel dose, exposure time, assay, and processing; marker-direction disagreement does not isolate a cell-context effect.
limitation: No matched factorial treatment-by-cell-line analysis or independent-culture effect estimate was performed.

claim: Repeat vehicle-matched paclitaxel exposure at shared dose and time points across independent A2780 and HCC1143 cultures, then compare replicate-aware marker or pathway effects.
limitation: This follow-up experiment has not been performed.
